discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators
motivation: Topological insulators changed how we classify electronic states in solids. Kane, with Mele, showed that spin-orbit coupling can produce a time-reversal-protected Z2 topological phase. He then extended the classification to three dimensions and showed how to diagnose it from band structure. Molenkamp's HgTe quantum-well transport experiments (2007) gave the first observation of the quantum spin Hall state, with quantized edge conductance. Hasan used angle-resolved and spin-resolved photoemission to directly image the Dirac surface states of Bi-based compounds and their spin-momentum locking, establishing three-dimensional topological insulators. Together, theory, transport and spectroscopy gave a coherent picture that holds across many materials and probes. The work launched the broader field of topological quantum matter, including Weyl semimetals and topological superconductivity, and transformed electronic-structure spectroscopy itself. This is a discovery of lasting, field-defining importance.
